uploads_bucket.description: S3 bucket where intake attachments land.

description.constant_value: Fires when any targeted compliance Config rule goes NON_COMPLIANT.
Acme Health evidence vault / audit log key
Intake Lambda: no ingress; egress only to S3/DynamoDB endpoints

evidence_lock_mode.description: Object Lock mode for the evidence vault. GOVERNANCE for the sandbox; COMPLIANCE is irreversible until retention expires.

evidence_retention_days.description: Default Object Lock retention for new evidence objects (governance mode; applies to objects written after a change).

lambda_reserved_concurrency.description: Reserved concurrency for the intake Lambda. -1 = unreserved. Accounts with the default limit of 10 cannot reserve any (AWS requires 10 unreserved); raise the quota, then set this.
